reviewer: Owner-authorized implementer self-review, with GPT-6 assistance; not an independent review

reviewScope.summary: Review of PR #93 feedback source corrections, restricted security-reporting link, Norwegian-English documentation and operational fail-closed boundaries.
evidence: Owner-reported local Node server tests 4/4 and focused Vitest tests 19/19 passed after code corrections.
Owner-reported ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, Vite build, bundle budget and circular dependency checks passed; latest documentation-only update passed Prettier and git diff --check.
Nhost schema installation and Hasura metadata tracking confirmed; reports and daily_count remained untracked with no ordinary role permissions.
Anonymous GraphQL responded no mutations exist; ordinary authenticated user role remains to be independently role-tested.
pg_cron 1.6 job 1 confirmed active on the daily schedule, with 37 succeeded runs and no remaining synthetic retention test report (owner-supplied SQL results).
Vercel firewall publication/coverage, server secret scoping, authenticated role denial, Preview receipt, and Production activation require distinct operational verification.

adversarialFindings.description: The feedback interface is present while the server-side inbox can still be disabled.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The API fails closed unless both FEEDBACK_INTAKE_ENABLED=true and a server-only administrator secret exist. Do not activate until abuse protection and end-to-end receipt tests pass.

adversarialFindings.description: Provider firewall coverage, scheduled purge execution and actual learner-role access are not certified by source-only tests.
adversarialFindings.resolution: These are separately identified activation gates; the source merge alone must not be represented as evidence of operational readiness.

adversarialFindings.description: The public feedback form is not an appropriate destination for reporting security vulnerabilities.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The app and both documentation languages direct disclosures to the separate GitHub private vulnerability intake, rather than the feedback service.

retrospective.summary: Owner-authorized self-review supports the fail-closed source candidate. No independent review was performed or claimed. Merge does not itself certify or activate the Nhost/Vercel service; activation requires verified external controls.
